description: This file defines the DefaultLimitsConfig class, which implements the LimitsConfig interface. It provides configuration parameters related to limits for headers, authentication subjects, 'things', policies, messages, and search paging sizes within the Eclipse Ditto service. It includes methods to instantiate the class from a configuration and to access these limit values.

classes.name: DefaultLimitsConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing LimitsConfig, encapsulating configuration limits related to headers, 'things', policies, messages, and search parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultLimitsConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getHeadersMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for headers.

methods.name: getAuthSubjectsMaxCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum count for authentication subjects.

methods.name: getPoliciesMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for policies.

methods.name: getMessagesMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for messages.

methods.name: getThingsSearchDefaultPageSize
methods.description: Returns the default page size for 'things' search.

methods.name: getThingsSearchMaxPageSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum page size for 'things' search.
